verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents automation-adjacent features: custom YAML rules, rule testing, private rules in the Registry, CI jobs and automated PR comments. Nothing in the evidence shows Semgrep itself versioning, reviewing, or rolling back those automations or rules. Keeping rule files in git would be a user-side workaround, and the API deprecation and versioning policy covers API endpoints, not user automations, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
